data.text:
Ram Chandra Yadav vs State Of Up And 4 Others on 18 July,
2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad 
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024 : Ahc:114360 
Court No. - 5 
Case :- Writ - A No. - 9859 of 2024
Petitioner :- Ram Chandra Yadav 
Respondent :- State Of Up And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Mahendra Kumar Yadav,Ram Chandra Yadav 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble J.J. Munir,J.
1. The petitioner, who is a Food Safety Officer, has been transferred in public interest from Azamgarh to Rampur. Transfer is an incident of service and the order has been made in public interest. There is no case of mala fides in fact or law pleaded or made out nor the violation of any statutory rule. 
2. Learned Counsel for the petitioner says that the petitioner has made a representation, seeking cancellation or the modification of the transfer order, dated 01.07.2024 addressed to the Additional Commissioner (Administration), Food Safety and Drug Administration, Lucknow, but the same has not been attended to.
3. In the circumstances, the Additional Commissioner (Administration), Food Safety and Drug Administration, Lucknow is ordered to pass necessary orders on the petitioner's pending representation dated 01.07.2024 within ten days of the receipt of a copy of this order in accordance Ram Chandra Yadav vs State Of Up And 4 Others on 18 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120389190/
1 with the transfer policy of the Government and communicate the result thereof to the petitioner within a week of the order being recorded. 
4. This petition is disposed of in terms of the orders aforesaid. 
5. Let this order be communicated to the Additional Commissioner (Administration), Food Safety and Drug Administration, Lucknow through the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Lucknow by the Registrar (Compliance) within 48 hours. 
Order Date :- 18.7.2024 Prashant D.
